hypotheses.name: Asian-Session Momentum Continuation
hypotheses.market_mechanism: Post-2022 central bank gold accumulation shifted price discovery to Asian hours. Asian session produces 77.2% of gold returns with +0.13 lag-1 autocorrelation. Session momentum reflects persistent institutional flow imbalance.
hypotheses.testable_hypothesis: If Asian session (00:00-08:00 UTC) closes positive, entering long at Europe open (08:00 UTC) and exiting at Europe close (14:30 UTC) generates positive expectancy after Exness costs.
hypotheses.timeframe: Signal: H1 session bars; Execution: M5
hypotheses.entry_concept: Long at Europe open (08:00 UTC) if prior Asia session return > 0. Entry on first M5 bar at 08:00.
hypotheses.exit_concept: Exit at Europe close (14:30 UTC) on last M5 bar. Stop-loss at fixed distance (default 200 points).
hypotheses.risk_sizing_concept: Contract-aware fixed fractional (1% equity). At $30: SL=200 pts → 0.01 lots risks $0.20 ≤ $0.30 budget. Feasible.
hypotheses.expected_frequency: ~250 trades/year (1 per day on positive Asia sessions)
hypotheses.cost_sensitivity: Exness spread median 200 pts (20 pips). Paper 12 assumes 0.02% cost. Headroom exists but Standard account spread is high. Sensitivity: 1.0x, 1.5x, 2.0x spread multiplier.
falsification_criteria: On Exness M5 2021-2024: Asian session return % < 50%
IS net expectancy <= 0 after costs at 0.01 lots
MC reshuffle: observed Sharpe not in top 5%
hypotheses.selection_reason: Strongest gold-specific intraday evidence; feasible at $30; low complexity; large cost headroom vs Paper 12 assumption

hypotheses.name: Session-Open Intraday Momentum
hypotheses.market_mechanism: First-period returns predict session remainder (momentum). Late-informed investors or institutional execution extend the move. Also reversal found in crypto (overreaction).
hypotheses.testable_hypothesis: First 3 M5 bars after session open (00:00, 08:00, 14:30 UTC) predict next 6 M5 bars direction in XAUUSDm.
hypotheses.entry_concept: At session open + 3 M5 bars, enter in direction of first 3-bar return if magnitude > threshold.
hypotheses.exit_concept: Fixed horizon (6 M5 bars = 30 min) or session-end. SL at 1.5x ATR.
hypotheses.risk_sizing_concept: Volatility-targeted (1% equity). INFEASIBLE at $30: M5 ATR ~10-20 pips → SL 15-30 pips → $15-30 risk at 0.01 lots > $0.30 budget. Needs ~$300 equity.
known_weaknesses: Paper 11 finds BOTH momentum AND reversal
High frequency = high cost drag (~83% equity/month)
hypotheses.cost_sensitivity: 3 trades/day × 20 pips spread = 60 pips/day = ~$60/day at 0.01 lots = 200% equity/month. PROHIBITIVE.
falsification_criteria: Regression coeff of first 3-bar on next 6-bar <= 0
Net expectancy <= 0 after costs at any feasible size
hypotheses.selection_reason: High frequency good for stats but INFEASIBLE at $30. Kept for documentation only.

hypotheses.name: US-Session Mean Reversion / Vol Fade
hypotheses.market_mechanism: US session has highest vol, zero/negative drift (-13.4%), 'high-variance information trading'. Large moves revert as information digested.
hypotheses.testable_hypothesis: US session M5 bars exceeding 2x session realized vol revert within 3-6 bars.
hypotheses.entry_concept: Counter-trend: fade moves > 2x session realized vol. Enter on next M5 bar.
hypotheses.exit_concept: Target: session VWAP or open. SL: 1x ATR. Max 6 bars or session end.
hypotheses.risk_sizing_concept: Vol-targeted 1% equity. INFEASIBLE at $30: high vol regime requires wider SL → min lot breach. Counter-trend in high vol = adverse selection.
known_weaknesses: Counter-trend in high vol = trend continuation risk
US session has fundamental drivers (FOMC, NFP)
Low trade count = low statistical power
hypotheses.cost_sensitivity: High vol = wider spreads. Counter-trend = paying spread against momentum. Slippage risk. Likely negative expectancy.
falsification_criteria: Large US bars do not revert (continuation > reversion)
Only works on FOMC days (not robust)
hypotheses.selection_reason: Interesting mechanism from Paper 12 but INFEASIBLE at $30 and mechanism unproven for gold.

hypotheses.name: Volatility-Regime-Conditioned Session Momentum
hypotheses.market_mechanism: Intraday predictability changes with vol, jumps, FOMC, liquidity. Real-rate regimes condition gold returns. Regime filtering improves signal-to-noise.
hypotheses.testable_hypothesis: Session momentum (001/002) generates higher risk-adjusted returns when conditioned on low vol, non-FOMC, low spread regimes.
hypotheses.entry_concept: Execute parent strategy signal ONLY when: realized vol < p40, not FOMC, spread < p40.
hypotheses.risk_sizing_concept: Same as parent. Use 001 as parent (feasible at $30). Fewer trades = lower total cost.
hypotheses.cost_sensitivity: Fewer trades = lower total spread cost. Filter selects low-spread periods. Net: likely improves cost profile.
falsification_criteria: Interaction term (signal x regime) not significant
Regime definition not robust across percentiles
hypotheses.selection_reason: Enhancement for 001 if 001 shows promise. Tests Paper 11/2 regime conditioning at M5.
